d: DIN-CENCN-2-POE Ethernet to Cresnet® Network Bridge with PoE

specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: 100 Mbps, autoswitching, autonegotiating, autodiscovery, full/half duplex, DHCP, web server, IEEE 802.3af and 802.3at Type 1 compliant

specs.label: Cresnet
specs.value: Cresnet server mode with two separate subnets

specs.label: USB
specs.value: Supports computer console via front panel USB 2.0 device port

specs.label: Memory Card
specs.value: (1) SD memory card slot; Accepts one SD or SDHC card for log file storage

specs.label: Power over Ethernet
specs.value: IEEE 802.3at Type 2 PoE+ Powered Device; Use PoE Class 0 Type 1 or PoE+ Class 4 Type 2 PSE; PoE Class 0 (12.95 W) 802.3at Type 1 PSE; PoE Class 0 (12.95 W) 802.3af Type 1 PSE; PoE+ Class 4 (25.5 W) 802.3at Type 2 PSE

specs.label: Construction chassis
specs.value: Light gray polycarbonate housing with polycarbonate label overlay, UL94 V-0 rated

specs.label: Construction mounting
specs.value: 35 mm DIN EN 60715 rail mount, DIN 43880 form factor for enclosures with 45 mm front panel cutout, occupies 9 DIN module spaces (162 mm)
